title: LVIN recycle(uint256) NEM-class gate: state-condition, reachable only via public Stake contract, burn bounded by caller reward — $0 extractable
closed_reasons: recycle() gated by require(stake == msg.sender, 'recycle fail'); stake = Stake contract 0xe120bBf90eb051A43A3BDc0408b194b6F99b488E
only reachable path is Stake.transfer -> sell() -> token.recycle(sellAmt); sellAmt = caller's accrued reward (balances+staticReward+dynamicReward)
dynamicReward = rc.getDynamicAmt - userDynamicAmt = 0 for arbitrary accounts; u.inAmt <= 3000e18 per order
burn = min(caller_reward, pairBal/3); max live single reward = 103995.84 LVIN (0.60% of pair) among 1241 stakers at HEAD (was 71604.52 at 129283473)
fresh attacker reward after one cycle = 13224.37 LVIN (~$59); stake round-trip nets ~-$600 (20% routed to dead-address liquidity)
even a privileged max-burn (r0/3) round trip loses ~$235 on a $20k buy at the live ~$97.6k pool
